final_message:
Fixed! The issue was that the `slugify` function replaced each non-alphanumeric character with a hyphen, which caused multiple consecutive characters (like spaces or punctuation) to create multiple hyphens. 

I changed the regex pattern from `[^a-z0-9]` to `[^a-z0-9]+` so it matches one or more non-alphanumeric characters as a single group and replaces them with just one hyphen. I also added `.strip("-")` to remove any leading or trailing hyphens.

All 5 tests now pass!
